description: This Java class implements a service for reading field configuration data from a database, specifically for address-related fields in the Fineract platform. It uses JDBC for database access and includes methods to retrieve configuration data based on entity type.

classes.name: FieldConfigurationReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for reading address field configuration data from the database.

classes.name: FieldMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to FieldConfigurationData objects.

methods.name: retrieveFieldConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of field configuration data for a specific entity, after authenticating the user.

methods.name: retrieveFieldConfigurationList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of field configuration data for a specific entity, similar to retrieveFieldConfiguration.
